title: Lossless PNG face frames of the 68 041 VoxBlink (FLAG_46) and 36 426 VoxCeleb2 (FLAG_53) face rows, re-cut exactly like the features

modes.train: not run by default: collect stages run only when forced (configs/modes.json collect_kind_runs_only_when_forced) and every collected dataset is read from FF_DATA/01_collected (class 'collected' is in always_saved_classes). Re-collecting: force the whole collect closure in ONE run, with a fresh FF_WORK and FF_USE_SAVED=collected (README.md of 11_collect): FF_FORCE=c37_vox2,c53_vox2b,c46_voxblink,c45_frames_vox2,c_frames_index,c63_frames,c87_frames_bridge,c63v_audio_cache. Forcing this stage alone mixes its new rows with the old frames / audio cache (sampling is not deterministic). Its kernel output (frames/*.zip) is kept nowhere except, renamed *.zipdata, inside face_frames_png.

env_note: FLAG_LOCAL / FLAG_SMOKE pinned to "0" so a value left in the caller's environment cannot switch the notebook into its local / smoke mode during a real run (smoke_env sets "1" under FF_SMOKE=1). FLAG_IN / FLAG_OUT would also bypass the runner's /kaggle paths if set by the caller and cannot be pinned here (a fixed value would be wrong): WP-A drops them from the inherited environment; never export them.

env_doc.FRAMES_TIME_LIMIT_H: default 11 (the original finished in about 5.6 h); outside Kaggle set it higher in the caller's environment, e.g. 48.
env_doc.FRAMES_RESUME_FROM: folder that CONTAINS the frames/ of an earlier, time-limited run (resume patch). Unset = original behaviour.

# [FF url] ProgramComputer/voxceleb became gated (auto-approved terms) after the run: token from the environment only, never
# printed; no HF_TOKEN -> {} = the original anonymous request.
FF_HF_HDR = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + __import__("os").environ["HF_TOKEN"]} if __import__("os").environ.get("HF_TOKEN") else {}
HF = "https://huggingface.co/datasets/ProgramComputer/voxceleb/resolve/" + FF_HF_REV("ProgramComputer/voxceleb") + "/vox2/"

run_policy: Frames are re-cut exactly like FLAG_46 / FLAG_53 (same frame, same 1.3x loose crop) from the collected index; the 13.54 chain uses the collected frames (skip_with). VoxBlink: private.
notes: Reads only frames-index (vb/selection, timestamps, shard_listing, face_meta of FLAG_46; vox2b/listing_{dev,test}_mp4.parquet + face_meta of FLAG_53).

No skip_with: the runner serves skip_with as a saved copy of the stage's KERNEL output, and no such copy exists (the FF_DATA/01_collected folders hold the exported datasets, which configs/data_map.json maps by their own ids). The stage is skipped by default because collect stages run only when forced.
post_checks make the notebook's own 'complete' flags fatal: a run stopped by FRAMES_TIME_LIMIT_H fails instead of being accepted.
